description: Ministry of Labour - Collective Agreements between Seylan Bank PLC, Vs Ceyon Bank Employees Union, HDFC Bank Vs. Ceylon Bank Employees Union, Next Manufacturing (Pvt) Ltd. Vs Free Trade Zones and General Services Employees Union
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a bank and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains legal/regulatory content including statutory instruments (the collective agreement), regulatory frameworks for employment terms, and compliance requirements. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory matters under existing legislation rather than government structure, personnel, or other specialized categories.
